suggestions: A permanent automated regression case for the execCommand clipboard fallback would improve coverage. The final parent verification separately exercised this fallback successfully, including actual clipboard readback and temporary-buffer cleanup.
summary: Independent read-only backend/frontend and final-control delta reviews found no blocker. Scope included exact live-goal scoping, canonical history, folder integrity, read receipts, request identity, navigation, safe DOM, copy controls, validation filtering and separate owner authorization. Reviewers did not certify production behavior. Final parent-run application, AMP, native integration and both browser suites passed on the recorded source manifest.
